text.card: A star about 85 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.3 solar radii and 2.70 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,026 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: 41 Lyncis
quotes.card: 41 Lyncis, also designated HD 81688 and named Intercrus, is a fifth-magnitude star located in the northern constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: An extrasolar planet is thought to be orbiting the star.
